name: Anantara Plaza Nice
insider_take: This Belle Époque palace sits majestically on Avenue de Verdun, where Nice's aristocratic past meets contemporary luxury just steps from the legendary Promenade des Anglais.
whats_special: The hotel occupies a historic 19th-century building that once housed Nice's elite, featuring original period details like soaring ceilings and ornate moldings. Its prime location puts you within walking distance of both the vibrant Old Town (Vieux Nice) and the glamorous Promenade des Anglais, while the rooftop terrace offers stunning views of the Mediterranean and the Baie des Anges.
pro_tip: Book a sea-view room on the upper floors for breathtaking sunrise views over the Mediterranean, and time your rooftop visits during the golden hour when the French Riviera coastline glows amber.
dont_miss: The famous Cours Saleya flower market is just a 5-minute stroll away – perfect for morning coffee and people-watching. The hotel's proximity to Place Masséna means you're at the heart of Nice's cultural district, with easy access to the Russian Orthodox Cathedral and the Marc Chagall Museum.
pros: Prime location on Place Masséna in the heart of Nice
Luxurious Anantara spa and wellness facilities
Elegant Belle Époque architecture with modern amenities
Walking distance to Old Town and French Riviera beaches
cons: Urban setting with city noise from busy square
Premium pricing due to prime location
